entities.name: UniProt:A0LJ64
observations: The 200-aa query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt A0LJ64, annotated as elongation factor Ts (EF-Ts) from Syntrophobacter fumaroxidans.
EF-Ts promotes GDP-to-GTP exchange on EF-Tu during bacterial translation elongation; annotated cytoplasmic.
